description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'ProductsApiResource' for managing product-related operations in the Fineract platform, including retrieving templates, products, listing, creating, updating, and handling commands for share products.

classes.name: ProductsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for product operations in Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a product template based on product type.

methods.name: retrieveProduct
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific share product by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllProducts
methods.description: Lists all share products with pagination support.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new share product with provided JSON data.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Handles commands for a specific product, such as updates or other actions.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing share product with provided JSON data.
